verdict.rationale: First-party RTX docs say the fifth-gen Tensor Cores support FP4, FP8, FP6, BF16, FP16 and TF32. The 5090 page documents 32 GB GDDR7, the CUDA Toolkit is the development base, and a review cites 'potent AI performance.' Nothing in the pack names a supported LLM serving stack for this card, so only the low-precision half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented TensorRT-LLM/vLLM/llama.cpp support for the RTX 5090, LLM-specific inference guidance or benchmarks, and independent hands-on corroboration of FP8/FP4 LLM inference on this part.
